title: Halving the size of skew-symmetric eigenvalue problems via the polar decomposition
summary: This paper introduces a novel algorithm for computing eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a dense real skew-symmetric matrix $A$. Its main ingredient is the computation of a polar factor of $A$ that is both skew-symmetric and orthogonal. This polar factor is then used to transform the original problem into a Hermitian eigenvalue problem of half the size, which can be solved accurately and efficiently with standard software such as LAPACK.
